text: House File 2084 - Introduced HOUSE FILE 2084 BY STONE A BILL FOR An Act relating to autologous and directed blood donations at 1 blood banks and hospitals. 2 BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF THE STATE OF IOWA: 3 TLSB 5561YH (1) 91 ak/ko H.F. 2084 Section 1. NEW SECTION . 135.39F Autologous or directed 1 blood donations. 2 1. For the purposes of this section: 3 a. “Autologous blood donation” means a blood donation made 4 by an individual for the individual’s own use. 5 b. “Blood bank” means the same as defined in section 141A.1. 6 c. “Directed blood donation” means a donation of blood 7 or blood components for the purpose of transfusion into a 8 specified individual. 9 2. A blood bank that facilitates autologous blood donations 10 or directed blood donations shall comply with an individual’s 11 request, based on a physician’s order for a medical procedure 12 that may require a blood transfusion, for an autologous blood 13 donation or directed blood donation. 14 3. An autologous blood donation or directed blood donation 15 collected pursuant to this section shall be subject to all 16 applicable federal and state laws and rules. 17 4. A blood bank may charge a reasonable fee for facilitating 18 an autologous blood donation or directed blood donation under 19 this section. 20 Sec. 2. NEW SECTION . 135B.36 Autologous or directed blood 21 donations. 22 1. For the purposes of this section: 23 a. “Autologous blood donation” means the same as defined in 24 section 135.39F. 25 b. “Directed blood donation” means the same as defined in 26 section 135.39F. 27 2. If a hospital licensed under this chapter facilitates 28 blood donations, the hospital shall comply with an individual’s 29 request, based on a physician’s order for a medical procedure 30 that may require a blood transfusion, for an autologous blood 31 donation or directed blood donation. 32 3. An autologous blood donation or directed blood donation 33 collected pursuant to this section shall be subject to all 34 applicable federal and state laws and rules. 35 -1- LSB 5561YH (1) 91 ak/ko 1/ 2 H.F. 2084 4. A hospital may charge a reasonable fee for facilitating 1 an autologous blood donation or directed blood donation under 2 this section. 3 EXPLANATION 4 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 5 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 6 This bill relates to autologous or directed blood donations 7 collected at blood banks and hospitals. 8 The bill requires a blood bank or hospital that facilitates 9 autologous or directed blood donations to comply with an 10 individual’s request, based on a physician’s order for 11 a procedure that may require a blood transfusion, for an 12 autologous or directed blood donation. 13 The bill provides that an autologous or directed blood 14 donation collected by a blood bank or hospital shall be subject 15 to all applicable federal and state laws and rules. The bill 16 allows both blood banks and hospitals to charge a reasonable 17 fee for facilitating an autologous or directed blood donation. 18 The bill defines “autologous blood donation”, “blood bank”, 19 and “directed blood donation” for purposes of the bill. 20 -2- LSB 5561YH (1) 91 ak/ko 2/ 2
